name: De Passage
address: Tussen Coolvest (later Coolsingel) en Korte Hoogstraat

architecture.description: Overdekte galerij met gietijzeren/glazen kap, twee flankerende woningstroken boven winkelpuien, rijk versierde eclectische toegangsgevel. Interieurhoogte20m is bronmaat; buitenbreedte/hoogte complete gevel nog kaart/fotogeschat.

sources.title: Ingang aan de Coolsingel
sources.author: Anoniem
sources.prompt: Carefully restore and colourize this exact archival photograph of Passage entrance Rotterdam in 1938. Preserve exact composition, camera position, all architecture, shop awnings, signage, windows and doors, people and trees. Keep 1938 clothing and street environment. Improve clarity and remove scan damage, full natural colour as if taken with a clean modern camera in the same historical scene. Do not invent details, do not redesign architecture, do not add or remove objects. Use subdued warm stone and brick, muted painted wood, natural foliage, soft daylight. All signs and lettering stay exactly as reference, including cigarette advertisement on top. Keep whole original framing and original ratio; no added border, captions or watermarks. Colours are plausible interpretations. Do not crop.
sources.aiNote: AI-kleurinterpretatie. Kleuren en fijne details niet historisch geverifieerd. Sommige letters vervormd.
